function.description: Find service providers based on various criteria such as rating, location, availability, and service types offered. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

avg_rating.description: The average review rating of the service provider on a scale of 1 to 5 stars. Use 'null' for unrated. This is a float type value.

province_id.description: ID of the province where the service provider is located. Example: 1 for Bangkok, 2 for Chiang Mai.

district_name.description: The name of the district where the service provider is located, or 'null' if not specified.

sub_district_name.description: The name of the sub-district where the service provider is located, or 'null' if not specified.

start_available_date.description: The start of the availability period for the service provider in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss', or 'null' for immediate availability.

end_available_date.description: The end of the availability period for the service provider in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss', or 'null' if open-ended.

min_age.description: The minimum age of the service provider, or 'null' if no preference.

max_age.description: The maximum age of the service provider, or 'null' if no preference.

has_quality_problem.description: Indicates whether the service provider has a record of quality problems (false for no record, true for having a record).

has_late_check_in.description: Indicates whether the service provider has a record of late check-ins (false for no record, true for having a record).

is_excellent.description: Indicates whether the service provider has a record of excellence (false for no record, true for having a record).

is_package.description: Indicates whether the job is a packaged offer (false for individual services, true for a package).

is_subscription.description: Indicates whether the job is subscription-based (false for one-time services, true for subscription).

service_id.description: ID of the service being offered by the provider. Example: 1 for cleaning service, 2 for ironing service.

available_for_pet.description: Indicates whether the service provider is available for households with pets (false for no, true for yes).

professional_group_id.description: ID of the professional group to which the service provider belongs. Example: 1 for Group A, 2 for Group B.

job_qty.description: The number of jobs the service provider has received, or 'null' if not applicable.

is_cleaning_condo.description: Indicates whether the service provider offers condo cleaning services (false for no, true for yes).

is_cleaning_home.description: Indicates whether the service provider offers home cleaning services (false for no, true for yes).

is_cleaning_office.description: Indicates whether the service provider offers office or workplace cleaning services (false for no, true for yes).

Sure! Finding a quick‑stop shop that’s open when you need it is easy once you know where to look. Below are some practical ways to spot a convenience store around **March 19th, 2024 at noon**—whether you’re traveling, living abroad, or just exploring your own town.

---

### 1️⃣ Quick Online Search  
| Platform | How to Use |
|----------|------------|
| **Google Maps / Apple Maps** | Type “convenience store” + your address or zip code. Filters let you see only those currently open (“Open now”). You’ll also see reviews, photos, and exact addresses. |
| **Yelp / TripAdvisor** | Great for traveler‑friendly spots; read recent visitor comments about cleanliness, staff friendliness, and product variety. |
| **Local chain websites** | Many big Thai chains (e.g., *FamilyMart*, *Seven & I* – formerly 7‑Eleven) list operating hours per outlet. |

> 👉 Tip: If you’re planning ahead, add `open` to your query (`“convenience store open March 19 12pm”`) so results show outlets still running during that window.

---

### 2️⃣ Popular Convenience Chains in Thailand  

| Chain | Typical Hours | What to Expect |
|-------|---------------|----------------|
| **FamilyMart** | 24 h (most locations) | Fresh food, snacks, drinks, basic groceries. |
| **Seven & i** | 24 h | Similar to FamilyMart but often slightly larger shelves. |
| **Tesco Lotus Express** | 10 am–11 pm | More extensive grocery selection, ready meals. |
| **Big C Mini** | 9 am–8 pm | Good for bulk items, fresh fruit, household supplies. |
| **Mango Market** | Varies (often 10 am–10 pm) | Trendy snack options, coffee shops inside. |

If you’re outside Thailand, most countries have comparable chains:
- USA: **Walmart Neighborhood Markets**, **CVS Pharmacy**, **7‑Eleven**
- UK: **Co-op Food**, **Nisa**, **Tesco Express**

---

### 3️⃣ Using Public Transit Apps  
Apps like **Moovit**, **Citymapper**, or even the local transit authority’s website usually mark retail stops along routes. Look under “Retail” or “Shopping” categories—they sometimes highlight convenience stores.

---

### 4️⃣ Ask Locals or Hotel Staff  
A quick chat with locals or front desk personnel can point you straight to the nearest 24‑hour shop. In many cities, there’s always a small corner market that stays open past midnight!

---

### 5️⃣ Offline Map Resources  
If you don’t have internet access:

1. Grab a paper map from a tourist information center.  
2. Mark major roads and note any labeled “Conveni­ence Store,” “Mini Mart,” or similar signs.  
3. Check the posted business hours next to each listing.

---

#### Sample Plan for March 19, 2024 at Noon

Assuming you’re in **Bangkok** (Province 1):

| Time | Activity | Suggested Stop |
|------|-----------|----------------|
| 09:30 | Breakfast | **FamilyMart** at Sukhumvit 71 (opens 07:00). |
| 11:45 | Snack before meeting | **Tesco Lotus Express** at Phra Khanong (opens 08:00). |
| 12:15 | Lunch break | **Seven & i** at Asok Intersection (24 h). |

All three are within walking distance of central BTS stations and stay open well after midday.

---

### Final Thought  
Because you mentioned a specific date/time (**19 Mar 2024 @ 12:00**), double‑check the chosen store’s holiday schedule—some places close early on public holidays. Most chains publish this on their official sites or via customer support lines.

Let me know if you’d like directions to a particular area or additional recommendations tailored to another country!
